evals.expected_output: Lists open ready-for-agent issues, stops for confirmation, and does not start the workflow.
expectations: The orchestrator resolves the current branch and checks it is not main/master.
The orchestrator fetches open ready-for-agent issues and prints a proposed batch.
The orchestrator does not call run_workflow until the user confirms or re-invokes with explicit numbers.

evals.expected_output: Creates a PLAN.json for issue 147, runs the Dynamic Workflow, and reports a draft PR or a BLOCKED reason.
expectations: PLAN.json includes repo, parent_branch, max (if supplied), and one issue entry for #147.
workflow.py reads PLAN.json and dispatches a single shared-vm agent with the CHILD_PROMPT.md template.
RESULTS.json contains the issue number, branch, pr_number, pr_url, status, and reason.

evals.expected_output: Processes at most three ready-for-agent issues in independent worktrees and rolls up RESULTS.json.
expectations: Only three issues are dispatched even if more are ready.
Each issue uses its own worktree and branch build/issue-<number>.
A summary line per ticket is written to RESULTS.json and reported to the user.

evals.expected_output: Processes child issues #101 and #102 of spec #100 in chained order if their bodies reference Parent #100.
expectations: The first child targets PARENT_BRANCH; the second child targets the first child's branch.
If the first child is BLOCKED, later children are recorded as BLOCKED with a predecessor reason.
